summary: The study investigates the structural and electronic properties of hafnia thin films deposited via atomic layer deposition (ALD) using hafnium tetrachloride and water at 300 °C. The films exhibit different crystalline phases and textures depending on their thickness, with polycrystalline monoclinic and tetragonal phases observed. The research combines experimental techniques like transmission electron microscopy (TEM), electron diffraction, and X-ray diffraction with theoretical density-functional theory (DFT) calculations to understand the microstructure and surface properties of the films.
